item.title: Remarks on the panel topic “Paths to prosperity - forging growth, trade and investment between Europe and Asia”

rating.summary: Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel spoke at a panel in Bangkok on Europe-Asia economic relations, covering trade, investment, and competitiveness. The remarks focused on deepening EU-Asia trade ties, diversification away from China, and strengthening European industrial and technological capabilities. No monetary policy topics such as interest rates, inflation, or the ECB's policy stance were addressed.
rating.stance_rationale: The speech is entirely focused on trade, investment, and economic competitiveness between Europe and Asia, with no monetary policy content whatsoever.
key_quotes: There is no single strategy for Europe towards Asia.
Strengthening European competitiveness and sovereignty should be a priority.
